name: Matsubushi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Matsubushi town emblem in red: a stylised swirl of two curved strokes like a wave.
history: Municipal flag of Matsubushi, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1969.

features.role: Matsubushi town emblem — a stylised swirl of two curved strokes like a wave
